meta.title: Emrah Kalfa — Technical Product Manager
meta.description: Technical Product Manager with 7+ years of experience across SaaS and AI products, connecting product strategy, engineering, and delivery.

summary.title: Summary
summary.body: Technical Product Manager who combines a software engineering foundation with product strategy. Leads SaaS and AI products across the full lifecycle—from discovery and prioritization to delivery and go-to-market—while aligning cross-functional teams of 15+ around clear outcomes. A background in .NET, mobile development, and software architecture helps turn business needs into practical technical decisions. Focused on creating measurable product value through disciplined prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and evidence-based decisions.

highlight.title: First Place — Anti Coup Hackathon
highlight.body: Led the development team to first place at a hackathon organized by the Presidency of Türkiye. The team built an AI-powered psychological analysis system that evaluated public sentiment around social events using emotion models on Twitter data and presented the results through real-time visualizations.

companies.name: Arbalet & Emakin
companies.note: Progressed from technical leadership to product management within Emakin.

roles.title: Technical Product Manager
bullets: Own product strategy and technical execution for Arbalet, an AI agent development platform.
Shape the platform vision around market needs, user expectations, and technical capabilities.
Prioritize the product backlog by business value, return on investment, and user feedback while coordinating sprint planning.
Align a cross-functional team of 15+ around shared product outcomes.
Turn insights from user research and competitive analysis into focused product decisions.

roles.title: Senior Backend Developer
bullets: Contributed to the core engineering teams behind Emakin BPM and Arbalet.
Designed scalable backend services in .NET 8 and C# to support dynamic data structures.
Created PostgreSQL schemas for high-volume data and improved query performance.
Introduced Docker-based containerization to make deployments more consistent.
Partnered with frontend teams to build reliable, maintainable RESTful APIs.

roles.title: Product Owner
bullets: Led sprint planning and backlog management to support the timely delivery of critical features.
Planned and conducted user acceptance testing to validate usability and quality before release.
Shaped product decisions around operational efficiency, profitability, and company goals.
Created process flows and requirements documentation that kept business and engineering aligned.

roles.title: Startup Consultant
bullets: Helped the team adopt Agile practices and establish a more disciplined sprint planning process.
Translated client needs into clear, actionable technical requirements for the development team.
Improved team focus and productivity through prioritization and resource planning guidance.

roles.title: Head of Project Management Office
bullets: Established project management standards spanning pre-sales through post-launch support.
Managed a multi-project portfolio and prioritized delivery by profitability and strategic value.
Identified project risks early and developed practical mitigation plans.
Designed training and performance review processes that supported team development.

roles.title: Technical Project Manager
bullets: Led cross-functional teams delivering identity verification systems for enterprise clients.
Balanced client expectations, scope, and technical constraints while coordinating the resolution of critical issues.
Contributed directly to Android and backend development during resource constraints to protect delivery timelines.

roles.title: Senior Developer & Team Leader
bullets: Provided technical leadership and mentorship to support the software team’s growth.
Created game concepts and Game Design Documents that shaped the company’s product direction.

roles.title: Co-Founder & Team Leader
bullets: Defined the company vision and product direction while managing operations, legal processes, and partnerships.
Led game projects end to end, from architecture and development through testing and delivery.
